terms.definition: A reusable, versioned output with lineage, ownership, quality evidence, and a lifecycle.
Deprecated Quirk term for reusable output.
A reliable outcome with defined inputs, outputs, authority, implementation, and evaluation.
A hard human-authorized rule or instruction that supersedes lower-priority behavior.
A named reroute into an asset, action, boundary, proof, ritual, offer, or other useful direction.
A trust-rich, identity-heavy group of complementary operators using fast informal coordination.
A versioned collection of machine-checkable and human-readable policy rules.
A provider-independent declaration of execution capability, limits, authority, and prohibitions.
A derived representation optimized for query or presentation that does not silently become canonical.
Controlled expansion that strengthens, connects, compounds, productizes, or proves completed work.

relations.definition: The subject cannot operate correctly without the object.
The subject creates an object as an intended output.
The subject accepts the object as an input.
The subject defines or enforces rules over the object.
The subject assesses the quality or state of the object.
The canonical subject is transformed into a derived representation.
The subject and object cannot both remain accepted without qualification.
